title: TAI owner direct REG.RU preflight authority
objective: Replace the lossy child workflow_dispatch with a direct owner-authorized TAI REG.RU preflight run that publishes the exact six-job authority expected by the existing restricted Qwen activation workflow.
boundaries: Command is accepted only on issue 3365
Comment author, actor and triggering actor must equal the repository owner
Target SHA is resolved from current main and revalidated before image inspection
TAI image revision, non-root runtime user and immutable digest are mandatory
REG.RU preflight runs only through the existing least-privilege self-hosted controller
The workflow publishes the six exact job names required by restricted Qwen activation
No Qwen activation or production mutation occurs before preflight PASS
